TASK BRIEF: Look up customer records in the CRM using the Unbreakable API Lite (Unbreakable API Lite)

FIT
Fully. The supplied customer endpoint provides the requested CRM customer-record lookup capability. No supplied requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
Bearer token authentication.
Header: Authorization: Bearer <userToken>
Supply a valid value for the collection variable `userToken`.

BASE URL
https://www.unbreakableapi.com

STEPS
1. GET /api/customers/
   Params:
     Authorization: bearer token — `Bearer <userToken>` — request header
     Query parameter `id` is shown in the schema but disabled, with no example value; do not send it unless the API requires an enabled customer filter.
   Returns:
     The request has no saved response examples, so the response status and body fields are not specified by the supplied schema.
   Threading:
     None

GOTCHAS
- Replace the empty `userToken` collection variable with a valid bearer token before calling the endpoint.
- The URL uses the resolved collection variable `baseUrl`: `https://www.unbreakableapi.com`.
- The `id` query parameter is disabled in the request schema, so this call does not specify a particular customer ID.
- The response shape and success status are not documented in the supplied request.
